content.text: {"subject":"Fractions: Halves and Quarters","aditiApplicable":true,"aditiHook":"When you share a pizza or a chocolate bar with a friend, you're already using fractions! Have you noticed how sometimes you get half and sometimes you get a quarter of something?","notes":["A fraction is a part of a whole — imagine breaking something into equal pieces","A half means dividing something into 2 equal parts — one half is written as 1/2","When you have a half, each part is the same size, and 2 halves together make 1 whole","A quarter means dividing something into 4 equal parts — one quarter is written as 1/4","When you have a quarter, each part is smaller than a half, and 4 quarters together make 1 whole","You can compare: 1 half (1/2) is bigger than 1 quarter (1/4) because halves are larger pieces","Example: A cake cut into 2 equal slices = halves; a cake cut into 4 equal slices = quarters"]}
